run_stretch_client_async_navigation: run a StretchClient to navigate the robot asynchronously to multiple goals using blocking=False
run_stretch_client_head_look_at_ee: run a StretchClient to move the robot head to look at the end effector
run_stretch_client_manipulator_pose: run a StretchClient to move the manipulator to a desired end effector pose asynchronously
run_stretch_client_wait_for_actions: run a StretchClient and wait for all pending navigation and manipulation actions to complete
run_stretch_client_mode_switching: run a StretchClient to switch between navigation mode and manipulation mode
